expects.description: Each high-risk requirement has a risk-management plan in its implementation plan and threat model.
A per-requirement implementation plan, with the traceability matrix, is on file.
An audit log snapshot covering the release window, or a log of the AI interactions that matter for risk.

clauses.title: Transparency and provision of information to deployers

expects.description: An AI-use disclosure or note is on file, listing every AI tool, where prompts come from and the human-oversight notes. Refresh it every 180 days, or sooner when an AI tool, model or kind of prompt is added or materially changed.
A release approval by a person is recorded as an audit event tied to the human reviewer, which provides human oversight of the release.
Records of what an AI agent changed and the human decision that followed it.
Test results from the delivery pipeline show accuracy and robustness.
Static-analysis results, a dependency audit or a security summary from the delivery pipeline.
